title.narrative: GSD/UPB/Accelerating SDG Localization through digital transformation. Fostering inclusive innovation to solve local challenges in Costa Rica/

description.narrative:
The Joint Programme will foster municipal-level digital transformation to improve the provision of quality, gender-transformative services, and to incubate solutions and opportunities for local SDG acceleration and economic development, with a gender perspective. In Costa Rica, the limited digital capacity of municipalities has been holding them back in terms of improved governance, provision of quality public services, economic planning, and community participation. Using e-government tools based on artificial intelligence, the JP will facilitate decision-making and public policy management to improve the localization of the SDGs and the provision of gender-transformative public services. Through innovative and participatory mechanisms, the JP will also boost the capacities of municipalities for SDG data analysis and management, planning, implementation, and accountability.
Working with existing digital labs, the JP will support co-creation and ideas incubation to build solutions to existing community problems and those that affect particularly women and improve the economic and political empowerment of the population, especially women.
In partnership with the Institute of Municipal Development (IFAM), and the Ministry of Science, Innovation, Technology, and Telecommunications (MICITT), the JP will work with the municipalities of Atenas, Palmares and Sarchí, already members of the Pro SDG Canton Network. Each municipality will in turn partner with an additional, more vulnerable municipality.
Among the key expected achievements include developing capacity at the municipal level for SDG data analysis and management, planning, implementation, and accountability integrating a gender perspective and expanded municipal data sets and data monitoring in line with the Global Urban Monitoring Framework based on the SDG Cities process.
